description: Get "who's doing what, where" (3W) humanitarian response data — which organizations are active in which sector (Health, Nutrition, WASH, etc.) and location. Filter by location_code (ISO3), sector_name, org_name, admin1_name, and admin_level. Data: HDX Humanitarian API (hapi.humdata.org), run by UN OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data, CC BY 4.0, no auth required.

admin1_name.description: 1st-level subnational admin area name to filter results, e.g. "Kayes"

location_code.description: ISO3 country code to filter results, e.g. "MLI", "AFG", "SOM"

location_name.description: Country name to filter results (alternative to location_code), e.g. "Mali"

offset.description: Number of rows to skip, for pagination (default 0)

org_name.description: Responding organization name to filter results, e.g. "UNICEF"

sector_name.description: Humanitarian sector name to filter results, e.g. "Health", "Nutrition"

name: hdx-hapi.coordination.operational_presence

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: HDX HAPI Operational Presence (3W)
